purpose: Unpatched W1L1 experiment aimed at the authored descriptor structures near x=1040..1168; distinguishes blocked ascent from ordinary travel without changing the archive or executable.

method.input: KBD_right sampled for 30 guest frames; the unpatched KBD_right+KBD_space phase begins at sample 31 near x=1401; right input continues afterward

observations.target_structure_crossing: The route crosses x=1040..1168 before the jump, in ordinary mode/correction; it does not test ascent through the authored descriptor structure. No 4368 predecessor or 41C1/41CF response is observed.
observations.mode_sequence: The sampled jump begins at x=1401,y=257, after the target structure; this run is an ordinary-corridor control and does not prove a ceiling response.

confirmed: The unpatched route does not reach the 4368 blocked-ascent predecessor in this corridor.
The existing static blocked-ascent implementation remains unvalidated against a natural ceiling.
No descriptor semantic or one-way name is promoted by this experiment.
still_open: A natural reachable ceiling that enters 4326 or 4368.
conclusion.evidence_policy: Retain as a negative control; do not use it to rename 0x20 or 0x40 descriptor bits.
